proves.claim: proofCounter keeps no prepared statement alive after its connection closes.

verify.proof.counter-release.why: A live statement kept the database file open and blocked cleanup.

proves.claim: evidence uses exact citations in tracked visible tests, and stage precedence follows sign-offs.

verify.evidence.citations.why: Loose citation matching let a clause count as proven without a real test.

proves.claim: an accept whose reviewed trunk is not an ancestor of main is judged from the merge base with the same overlap rule.

verify.freshness.trunk-merge-base.why: A trunk off main was wrongly judged stale or fresh.

proves.claim: each failure cause of the freshness check has its own reason text.

verify.freshness.reasons.why: One shared reason hid which check failed.

proves.claim: machine acceptance gives the accept move a real notBuilder check and passes it for a seat-built item.

verify.machine.not-builder.why: Machine acceptance once skipped the builder check.

proves.claim: machine acceptance refuses NOT_SUBMITTED for an item that left submitted.

verify.machine.not-submitted.why: An accept recorded on an item that was no longer submitted.

proves.claim: machine acceptance refuses NOT_SUBMITTED on the live row when the item leaves submitted after the precheck.

verify.machine.not-submitted-live.why: A race between the precheck and the write let a stale accept through.

proves.claim: two branches that each add a plan shard row and a data-read row compose in both orders on review retry.

verify.review.plan-compose.why: Review retry refused a merge that composes cleanly.

proves.claim: a row edited differently on both sides still refuses MERGE_CONFLICT on review retry.

verify.review.plan-conflict.why: Composition must never hide a true conflict.

proves.claim: main adding a far-away registry entry leaves the reviewed change fresh.

verify.freshness.far-registry-entry.why: Item #2896: unrelated registry growth made verdicts stale.

proves.claim: a conflicting or hunk-changing main edit keeps the verdict stale.

verify.freshness.conflicting-edit.why: Item #2896: freshness must still catch a real change.

proves.claim: two items adding registry entries in sequence both stay fresh.

verify.freshness.sequential-entries.why: Item #2896: the second landing made the first verdict stale.

proves.claim: main editing a nearby line that only changes hunk context leaves the reviewed change fresh.

verify.freshness.nearby-context.why: A context-only change made verdicts stale.

proves.claim: a verified item whose reviewed trunk is an ancestor of main is fresh, not STALE_VERDICT.

verify.freshness.ancestor-fresh.why: Ancestor trunks were refused as stale.

proves.claim: the ancestor check runs through the Git adapter, so a trunk on main raises no ReferenceError.

verify.freshness.ancestor-adapter.why: A missing adapter import crashed the check.

proves.claim: ancestryStatus spawns at most 3 git processes for 1,038 verified items with unchanged answers.

verify.freshness.batched-git.why: One git process per item made the check too slow.

proves.claim: with verify.frozenTests unset or false, a changed named test file is accepted.

verify.frozen.setting-off.why: The frozen-test refusal ships behind a default-off setting.

proves.claim: with verify.frozenTests true, a changed file is refused with TEST_HASH_CHANGED.

verify.frozen.setting-on.why: The setting must actually turn the refusal on.

proves.claim: the frozen hash of each named test file is recorded whatever the setting.

verify.frozen.hash-recorded.why: Turning the setting on later needs hashes already recorded.

proves.claim: only existing test files the criterion names are hashed.

verify.hash.named-only.why: Hashing unnamed or missing files froze the wrong content.

proves.claim: a hash already frozen is kept, not read again.

verify.hash.kept.why: Re-reading let a changed file replace its own frozen hash.

proves.claim: a builder edit is a change, while identical or main-supplied content is not.

verify.hash.change.why: Main-supplied content must not count as a builder edit.

proves.claim: the refusal names the file, and only a person ruling on that exact content lifts it.

verify.hash.ruling.why: Only the person may change a frozen test.

proves.claim: a bar frozen without hashes freezes nothing.

verify.hash.no-hashes.why: Older bars have no hashes and must not refuse.

proves.claim: a named test file the head adds is recorded with its seat and family, and an unchanged one is not.

verify.author.recorded.why: The author record is needed for the author and reviewer split.

proves.claim: a file already recorded at this content is not recorded twice, and a changed one is.
the newest author record per file is the one show prints.
a second loaded copy of the worker front door keeps its own process state.

verify.advance.copy-state.why: Shared module state leaked handles between copies.

proves.claim: the runner move preserves strict review for every strict planned source.

verify.advance.strict-review.why: A runner move once dropped strict review.

proves.claim: queue and status find file collisions through a path index and match the all-pairs answer.

verify.queue.path-index.why: All-pairs collision search was too slow.

proves.claim: queue on a 3,000-item fixture runs in under 200 ms.

verify.queue.speed.why: Queue speed regressed with board size.

proves.claim: every verify-cell test has a stable ID and exactly one complete record, and no record is orphaned.

verify.registry.complete.why: Tests keyed by path rekey on every move; IDs and records make each test a bar.

proves.claim: with verify.testAuthorSplit unset, a test file the submitting seat changed is accepted.

verify.authorsplit.setting-off.why: The author split ships behind a default-off setting.

proves.claim: with verify.testAuthorSplit true, an item whose test file the submitting seat changed is refused with TEST_AUTHOR_SAME_SEAT.

verify.authorsplit.same-seat.why: The strict option needs a separate test author.

proves.claim: with verify.testAuthorSplit true, a different recorded author at the same content hash is accepted.

verify.authorsplit.other-author.why: A separate author must satisfy the split.

proves.claim: with tests.registryStrict off the registry check names an unregistered test in its report and passes.

verify.registry.report-names-file.why: A hard failure blocked ordinary work before the registry rule was approved.

proves.claim: with tests.registryStrict on the registry check fails an unregistered test and names its file.

verify.registry.strict-fails.why: The person needs a switch that makes the registry rule binding.
